MINUTES
  ADJOURNED PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION
  June 19, 2017

  An adjourned meeting of the Park and Activities Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates
  was called to order at 6:00 p.m. at George F Canyon Nature Center, 27305 Palos Verdes Drive
  East, Rolling Hills Estates, California, by CHAIR ROMANELLI.

  COMMISSIONERS PRESENT:  Romanelli, Portugal, Giglia, Persichina, and Wroan

  COMMISSIONERS ABSENT:  Chair Pope, Retz

  STAFF PRESENT:  Andy Clark, Community Services Director

  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION DRAFT MINUTES, MAY 15, 2017

  COMMISSIONER PORTUGAL moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER GIGLIA

  TO APPROVE THE PARK & ACTIVITES MEETING MINUTES OF MAY 15,
  2017.

  THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR ROMANELLI SO ORDERED.

  AUDIENCE ITEMS/WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS NOT ON THE AGENDA

  None.

  CONSENT CALENDAR

 A.  STREET TREE REMOVAL APPLICATIONS

  •  4715 Rockbluff Drive
  •  29 Rollingwood Drive

 Director Clark provided the Park & Activities Commission with a brief summary of the requests to
 remove street trees at property address, 4715 Rockbluff Drive and 29 Rollingwood Drive.

 Commissioner Wroan inquired about the problem with the trees.

 Mel Aou, Property Owner, 4715 Rockbluff Drive, reported to staff that he has paid to clear drains
 and is requesting to remove the tree at his own cost since the roots are growing through the clay
 pipes.

 Ken Hua, Property Owner, 29 Rollingwood Drive, reported to staff that he is having similar
 plumbing issues.

 Commissioner Giglia suggested reviewing offers from CalWater for insurance on plumbing lines
 which includes repair of the main line.

  COMMISSIONER PERSICHINA moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER GIGLIA

  TO APPROVE THE REMOVAL AND REPLACEMENT OF STREET TREES
  LOCATED IN FRONT OF 4715 ROCKBLUFF DRIVE AND 29 ROLLINGWOOD
  DRIVE AT THE COST OF EACH APPLICANT.

  THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR ROMANELLI SO ORDERED.

 BUSINESS ITEMS

 A. PVP LAND CONSERVANCY QUARTERLY REPORT

 Adrienne Mohan, Conservation Director, PVP Land Conservancy, provided a brief summary of

ADJOURNED PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION
MINUTES  1
JUNE 19, 2017
  the PVP Land Conservancy Quarterly Report. Ms. Mohan stated that there is a need to recruit
 and train docents and any assistance with spreading the word is appreciated.

 B. PROPOSED OUTDOOR EDUCATION FACILITIES GRANT APPLICATION

 Community Services Director Clark stated that there is a State Grant available for up to 500K to
 improve outdoor facilities and provided a list of items for improvement of the George F Canyon
 Nature Preserve. The applications are due September 1, 2017.

 The Park & Activities Commissioners agreed that they would like to submit applications for more
 City Parks which will require one grant application per park. The Commissioners agreed that
 more time is needed to assess the needs in parks throughout the City.

  COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER GIGLIA

  TO TABLE THIS ITEM TO THE NEXT PARK AND ACTIVITIES MEETING OF
  JULY 17, 2017 IN ORDER TO ALLOW THE COMMISSIONER’S WITH TIME
  TO ASSESS THE NEEDS OF OTHER OUTDOOR FACILITIES.

  THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR ROMANELLI SO ORDERED.

 C. ROMANIAN FESTIVAL REQUEST

 Community Services Director Clark stated that a request was received from the Romanian
 Traditions in California Organization for the use of Ernie Howlett Park to host a small 2-day festival
 in October 2017. They will be using the picnic benches near the tennis courts, the basketball
 court, and the kitchen facilities.

  COMMISSIONER PERSICHINA moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER PORTUGAL,

  TO RECOMMEND THAT THE CITY COUNCIL APPROVE THE ROMANIAN
  TRADITIONS IN CALIFORNIA ORGANIZATION’S USE OF ERNIE HOWLETT
  PARK FOR ITS ROMANIAN FESTIVAL ON SATURDAY, OCTOBER 7 AND
  SUNDAY, OCTOBER 8, 2017 UNDER THE CONDITIONS AS STATED IN
  THE STAFF REPORT.

  AYES:  CHAIR ROMANELLI, PORTUGAL, PERSICHINA, GIGLIA, WROAN
  NOES:
  ABSENT:  POPE, RETZ
  ABSTAIN:

 D. STREET ENTRYWAY BEAUTIFICATION PROGRAM FUNDING REQUEST

 COMMISSIONER PORTUGAL recused herself from this item.

 Community Services Director provided a brief overview on this item. The request is for $2,500 in
 the 2016/2017 FY with an anticipated request of an additional $2,500 in the 2017/2018 FY to
 reconstruct the entryway for Rolling Hills Country Club Estates which was impacted by projects
 surrounding the neighborhood.

 Suzy Seamans, Representative, Rolling Hills Country Club Estates HOA, provided an overview
 on the proposed design of the entryway and signage.

 COMMISSIONER GIGLIA asked about the inconsistency in color for the proposed sign.

 Ms. Seamans stated that they were looking for a contrast since the entryway has a lot of white
 already.

 COMMISSIONER’S GIGLIA AND WROAN expressed their concern with the inconsistency in
 color.

 Ms. Seamans stated that the design is not final. She added that the entryway will match the
 entryway of the new golf course and they would like to add lights to the design to help with visibility.

 Ms. Seamans stated that the City should provide additional assistance to the homeowners since
 this is the first project where a new development has demolished an entire entryway without an
 obligation to pay for its reconstruction.

ADJOURNED PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION
MINUTES  2
JUNE 19, 2017
  COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI suggested granting the entire $5,000 requested in order to avoid
 having to return with the same request the following fiscal year. The PARK AND ACTIVITIES
 COMMISSION held a brief discussion regarding the size of this project and believed the balance
 of funds in the street entryway account could be approved for this project.

  COMMISSIONER PERSICHINA moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER GIGLIA,

  TO RECOMMEND THAT THE CITY COUNCIL APPROVE THE ROLLING
  HILLS COUNTRY CLUB ESTATES REQUEST AND GRANT UP TO $5,775 IN
  MATCHING FUNDS FROM THE CITY’S STREET ENTRYWAY
  BEAUTIFICATION PROGRAM IN FY 2016-2017.

  AYES:  CHAIR ROMANELLI, PERSICHINA, GIGLIA, WROAN
  NOES:
  ABSENT:  POPE, RETZ
  ABSTAIN:  PORTUGAL

 COMMISSION ITEMS (VERBAL REPORTS)

 A.  ADOPT-A-PARK REPORT

 COMMISSIONER GIGLIA stated that the lock on the electrical box at Ernie Howlett Park is
 missing.

 COMMISSIONER PORTUGAL stated that a part of the play equipment is unlatched or broken at
 Ernie Howlett Park.

 In response to COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI’s inquiry of whether the water fountain has been
 unplugged in Rockbluff Park, Community Services Director Clark stated that it had been repaired.

 DIRECTOR’S ITEMS (VERBAL REPORTS)

 A.  TRACY AUSTIN DOUBLES TENNIS TOURNAMENT CONCESSIONS, JULY 22-23

 Community Services Director Clark provided the Park and Activities Commission with a sign-up
 sheet to volunteer for this event.

 B.  LITTLE FREE LIBRARY UNITS

 Community Services Director Clark stated that all six of the Little Free Library Units are being well
 used.

 C.  BROWN ACT COMPLIANCE MANUAL

 Community Services Director Clark provided the Park and Activities Commission with a copy of
 the Brown Act Compliance Manual (2017), which was provided by the City Attorney.

 D.  TECHNOLOGY AND MANAGING RISKS

 Community Services Director Clark provided the Park and Activities Commission with a copy of
 the CJPIA presentation notes on Technology and Managing Risks and stated that City e-mails
 will be provided in the near future.

 TOURS OF NATURE CENTER, PRESERVE AND DAPPLEGRAY PARK

 Tour of Nature Center and Preserve
 Adrienne Mohan, Conservation Director, took the Park and Activities Commission on a brief tour
 of the Nature Center followed by a self-guided tour on the adjacent trail.

  •  Items noted: Dry brush needs to be cleared in the meadow, and a request for trash bin(s)
  along the trail.

ADJOURNED PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION
MINUTES  3
JUNE 19, 2017
  Tour of Dapplegray Park

  •  Items noted: Portable restroom in disrepair.

 ADJOURNMENT

 COMMISSIONER PERSICHINA moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER WROAN to,

  ADJOURN THE PARK AND ACTIVITIES MEETING

 THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR ROMANELLI adjourned the meeting at 7:34 p.m. to the
 Adjourned Park & Activities Commission Meeting of July 17, 2017 at 6:00 p.m. at Highridge Park,
 29035 Highridge Road, Rolling Hills Estates, CA 90274.

  Respectfully submitted,  Approved,

  __________________________  _________________________
  Carol Corea  Douglas R. Prichard
  Minutes Secretary  City Clerk

ADJOURNED PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION
MINUTES  4
JUNE 19, 2017
